name: Bitwarden
description: Connects one Bitwarden Secrets Manager project to Cockpit's vault, so agents can use its secrets without ever seeing a value: vault_run starts a command you approve with the secret in its environment. Uses a machine account through the official `bws` CLI, which Cockpit can install (SHA-256 verified) or which you pin on PATH. The machine account must read exactly one project, ideally a separate one such as "Agents"; a token that reads more is refused. Needs Cockpit's credential encryption to be on: the token is stored encrypted by the vault and handed to `bws` only as BWS_ACCESS_TOKEN in its environment.
author: Cockpit
